title: TODQA: Efficient Task-Oriented Data Quality Assessment
motivation: 现有数据质量评估 disconnected from application contexts, measure individual pieces not collections, 无法高效处理大规模数据
problem_framing: task-oriented quality assessment: 量化intrinsic/contextual quality dimensions, 用rank aggregation融合不可比的维度并排序datasets
key_insight: 引入task relevancy和content diversity两个新维度, 用LSH+采样实现near-linear快速计算, 把多维度融合建模成rank aggregation问题
method_signature: LSH+采样快速计算task relevancy和content diversity, Kendall tau距离rank aggregation
evaluation_criteria: runtime减少90%且accuracy loss很小, 排序结果与模型性能一致
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: random sampling方法accuracy略好但our method更高效; equal weights导致排序与accuracy ranking不一致
evidence_for_taste: the latter is more commonly used
measure quality of an individual data piece
measurements of different dimensions are not comparable
our algorithm can save about 90% computing time with little accuracy loss
thinking_moves: 从衡量单个数据点到衡量数据集整体特性
把质量融合的incommensurability问题重新frame成rank aggregation
用LSH近似算法解决exact计算在规模化下的不可行性
承认random sampling accuracy略好但选择efficiency优先
cites_own_work: Crowdbuy privacy-friendly image dataset purchasing via crowdsourcing
